# Setup
```{r}
# clear environment
rm(list = ls())

# load packages
library(pacman)
p_load(
  tidyverse, 
  readxl, 
  scales, 
  ggpattern, 
  hrbrthemes, 
  ggtext, 
  gridExtra, 
  haven, 
  splines, 
  patchwork, 
  cowplot, 
  janitor
       )

# set paths
## note: set the following to where the data are saved (and where output/figure folders are created)
root_dir <- dirname(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path))
root_dir

data_path       <- file.path(root_dir, "data") 
out_path        <- file.path(root_dir, "output")
fig_path        <- file.path(out_path, "figures")
```

# Load Data
```{r, warning=FALSE}
# Figure 1: Panel a
## 2010 data
## source: intermediate output from full Queued Up data file
df_2010 <- read_xlsx(
  file.path(data_path, "14_queues_vs_installed.xlsx"),
  sheet = "2010"
  )

## 2023 data
## source: intermediate output from full Queued Up data file
df_2023 <- read_xlsx(
  file.path(data_path, "14_queues_vs_installed.xlsx"),
  sheet = "2023"
  ) %>% 
  head(-2)
  
# Figure 1: Panel b
## historical queue data
## source: intermediate output from full Queued Up data file
q_hist <- read_xlsx(
  file.path(data_path, "12_queue_time_series_region.xlsx"),
  sheet = "Sheet1"
  )
  
# Figure 1: Panel c
## full Queued Up data file
## note: Queue data available here: https://emp.lbl.gov/queues
queue_df <- read_xlsx(
  file.path(data_path, "queues_2023_clean_data_r1.xlsx"),
  sheet = "data",
  col_types = "text"
  )
  
# Figure 1: Panel D
## historical queue completion rates
## source: intermediate output from full Queued Up data file
comp_rate <- read_xlsx(
  file.path(data_path, "comp_rates.xlsx"),
  sheet = "all"
  )

# Figure 2  
  
# Historical EIA capacity additions 
## note: this section uses EIA 860 data analyzed/prepped by LBL staff
historical_additions <- read_xlsx(
  file.path(data_path,"EIA 860 installations_joule_ix.xlsx"),
  sheet = "EIA_860_data",
  range = "K5:M25"
  )

# 2035 Report data 
## source: (https://www.2035report.com/electricity/downloads/)
## note: new capacity additions data from 'new_cap_gen.csv' file; assume CES90, base financing, AEO gas, ATBModified tech cost
cap_2035 <- read_xlsx(
  file.path(data_path, "2035_report_data.xlsx"),
  sheet = "2035_report_additions",
  range = "A1:G161"
  )

# Princeton Net Zero America
## source: https://netzeroamerica.princeton.edu/data-sheets
## E+RE+ Scenario // PILLAR 2: Clean Electricity
nza_capacity <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_path, "NZA_installed_capacity_E+RE+.csv"))

## E- Scenario // PILLAR 2: Clean Electricity
nza_e_minus_cap <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_path, "NZA_installed_capacity_E-.csv"))

# Williams et al. capacity projections
## source: https://github.com/EvolvedEnergyResearch/AGU_carbon_neutral_pathways/blob/main/AGU_detailed_output_data.xlsx
agu_capacity <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_path, "incremental_capacity_williams_et_al.csv")
  )

# NREL 
## source: https://scenarioviewer.nrel.gov/
nrel_df <- read.csv(file.path(data_path, "StdScen23_allScenarios_annual_balancingAreas.csv"),
                    skip = 2)

```


# Create Figures
## Figure 1:

### (a) Installed vs. active Queue, all regions, by type
#### Prep data
```{r}
# bind 2010 and 2023 installed capacity + queue data
installed <- rbind(df_2010, df_2023)
installed %>% count(Type)

# collapse by type
installed <- installed %>% 
  mutate(type2 = case_when(
    Type == "Solar (Hybrid)" ~ "Solar",
    Type == "Gas" ~ "Gas",
    Type == "Offshore Wind" ~ "Wind",
    Type == "Wind" ~ "Wind",
    Type == "Solar" ~ "Solar",
    Type == "Storage" ~ "Standalone Storage",
    Type == "Storage (Hybrid)" ~ "Hybrid Storage",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

installed <- installed %>% 
  group_by(type2, Source, Year) %>% 
  summarise(GW = sum(GW))

installed$type2 <- factor(installed$type2, levels = c("Solar", "Standalone Storage", "Hybrid Storage", "Wind", "Gas", "Other"))

install_total <- installed %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(Source, Year) %>% 
  summarise(GW = sum(GW)) %>% 
  ungroup()

# define values for peak hourly load
peak_load_2010 <- 710
peak_load_2023 <- 740 

color_palette_a <- c(
  "darkgoldenrod2", # solar
  "steelblue3", # standalone storage
  "steelblue4", #hybrid storage
  "forestgreen", #wind
  "gray80", #gas
  "sienna" # other
)

legend_data <- data.frame(x = 1.5, y = NA, label = "\u25C0", legend_label = "Triangle Symbol")


```

#### Create chart
```{r}
# plot: Installed vs. active Queue, all regions, by type
install_v_active_plot <-
  ggplot(data = installed, 
         aes(x = Source, y = GW, fill=type2)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", 
           stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(data = install_total, 
        aes(x = Source, y = GW + 2, label = comma(round(GW))), 
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), 
        vjust = -0.25,
        size = 3,                     
        hjust = 0.5,
        inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~Year) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette_a) +
  theme_bw() +
  ylab("Capacity (GW)") + 
  xlab("") +
  ggtitle("(a) Installed and active generation/storage capacity in queues: all regions") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0),
                     limits = c(-10, 2725),
                     breaks = c(0, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500), 
                     labels = comma) +
  geom_text(data = subset(installed, Year == 2010), aes(x = 1.51, y = peak_load_2010, label = "\u23f4 "), 
            size = 4.25, color = "black", vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = subset(installed, Year == 2023), aes(x = 1.51, y = peak_load_2023, label = "\u23f4 "), 
            size = 4.25, color = "black", vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = subset(installed, Year == 2010), aes(x = 0.35, y = 2400, label = "\u23f4 Peak Hourly Load for \n Continental U.S."), 
            size = 4, color = "black", vjust = 0.5, hjust = -0.1) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, vjust = 0.1),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(r = 5)),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8.5),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 11),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.17, "cm"),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), 
        legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 6)) +
  labs(fill = "Panels (a) & (b):") 


install_v_active_plot 



```

### (b) Active capacity by region and type
#### Prep data
```{r}
# reshape to long
q_hist_long <- pivot_longer(q_hist,
                            cols=3:9,
                            names_to="type",
                            values_to="GW")

# remove years prior to 2014
q_hist_long <- q_hist_long %>% 
  filter(Year > 2013)

# rename regions (make shorter names for non-ISO)
q_hist_long$Region[q_hist_long$Region == "West non-ISO"] <- "West"
q_hist_long$Region[q_hist_long$Region == "Southeast non-ISO"] <- "Southeast"

q_hist_long %>% count(Region)

# remove all regions category
q_hist_long <- q_hist_long %>% 
  filter(Region != "All Regions")

# limit to solar, storage, wind, gas
q_hist_long %>% count(type)

q_hist_long <- q_hist_long %>% 
  mutate(type2 = case_when(
    type == "Hybrid Storage*" ~ "Hybrid Storage",
    type == "Offshore Wind" ~ "Wind",
    type == "Other***" ~ "Other",
    type == "Wind**" ~ "Wind",
    TRUE ~ type
  )
  )

q_hist_long %>% count(type, type2)

q_hist_long <- q_hist_long %>% 
  filter(type2 != "Other")

q_hist_long <- q_hist_long %>% 
  select(-type) %>% 
  rename(type = type2)

q_hist_long %>% count(type)

# collapse wind
q_hist_long <- q_hist_long %>% 
  group_by(Region, type, Year) %>% 
  summarise(GW = sum(GW, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  ungroup()

# reorder factor variables:
q_hist_long$Region <- factor(q_hist_long$Region, levels = c("West", "CAISO", "MISO", "PJM",
                                                  "ERCOT", "Southeast", "NYISO", "SPP", 
                                                  "ISO-NE"))

q_hist_long$type <- factor(q_hist_long$type, levels = c("Hybrid Storage", "Standalone Storage", "Solar", "Wind", "Gas"))

color_palette_b <- c(
  "steelblue4", #hybrid storage
  "steelblue3", # standalone storage
  "darkgoldenrod2", # solar
  "forestgreen", #wind
  "gray80" #gas
)


```

#### Create chart
```{r}
# plot: (b) Active capacity by region and type
q_hist_plot <- ggplot(data = q_hist_long, aes(x = Year, y = GW, fill = type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  facet_grid(~Region) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette_b) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 750),
    breaks = c(0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700), labels = comma
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2014, 2023)) +
  theme_bw() +
  ylab("Total Capacity in Queues (GW)") +
  xlab("") +
  ggtitle("(b) Active capacity by region and type") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(color = NA),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 8.15),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.3),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) 


q_hist_plot

```

### (c) Duration from IR to IA, 2014-2022
#### Prep data
```{r, warning=FALSE}
## clean ia date
q_clean <- queue_df %>%
  mutate(
    ia_date_raw = ia_date,
    ia_date = case_when(
      # for Excel serial dates (like 43112 or 39568.291666666701)
      grepl("^\\d{5}(\\.\\d+)?$", ia_date_raw) ~ as.Date(as.numeric(ia_date_raw), origin = "1899-12-30"),
      
      # for dates in format mm/dd/yyyy
      grepl("^\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{4}$", ia_date_raw) ~ mdy(ia_date_raw),
      
      # for dates in format yyyy-mm-dd
      grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", ia_date_raw) ~ ymd(ia_date_raw),
      
      # If none of the above patterns match, try parsing with parse_date_time
      TRUE ~ as.Date(parse_date_time(ia_date_raw, orders = c("ymd", "mdy", "dmy", "my")))
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ia_date = if_else(
      is.na(ia_date),
      as.character(ia_date_raw),  # keep original if parsing failed
      format(ia_date, "%m/%d/%Y")
    )
  )

## q_date
q_clean <- q_clean %>%
  mutate(
    q_date_raw = q_date,
    q_date_raw = if_else(q_date_raw == "11/17.17", "11/17/2017", q_date_raw),
    q_date_raw = if_else(q_date_raw == "10/21/221", "10/21/2021", q_date_raw),
    q_date = case_when(
      # for Excel serial dates (like 43112 or 39568.291666666701)
      grepl("^\\d{5}(\\.\\d+)?$", q_date_raw) ~ as.Date(as.numeric(q_date_raw), origin = "1899-12-30"),
      
      # for dates in format mm/dd/yyyy
      grepl("^\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{4}$", q_date_raw) ~ mdy(q_date_raw),
      
      # for dates in format yyyy-mm-dd
      grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", q_date_raw) ~ ymd(q_date_raw),
      
      # if none of the above patterns match, parse with parse_date_time
      TRUE ~ as.Date(parse_date_time(q_date_raw, orders = c("ymd", "mdy", "dmy")))
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    q_date = if_else(
      is.na(q_date),
      as.character(q_date_raw),  # keep original if parsing failed
      format(q_date, "%m/%d/%Y")
    )
  )

check <- q_clean %>% 
  distinct(q_date, q_date_raw)

q_clean <- q_clean %>%
  mutate(
    on_date_raw = on_date,
    on_date_raw = if_else(str_detect(on_date_raw, "NULL"), as.character(NA), on_date_raw),
    on_date = case_when(
      # for Excel serial dates (like 43112 or 39568.291666666701)
      grepl("^\\d{5}(\\.\\d+)?$", on_date_raw) ~ as.Date(as.numeric(on_date_raw), origin = "1899-12-30"),
      
      # for dates in format mm/dd/yyyy
      grepl("^\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{4}$", on_date_raw) ~ mdy(on_date_raw),
      
      # for dates in format yyyy-mm-dd
      grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", on_date_raw) ~ ymd(on_date_raw),
      
      # If none of the above patterns match, try parsing with parse_date_time
      TRUE ~ as.Date(parse_date_time(on_date_raw, orders = c("ymd", "mdy", "dmy", "my")))
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    on_date = if_else(
      is.na(on_date),
      as.character(on_date_raw),  # keep original if parsing failed
      format(on_date, "%m/%d/%Y")
    )
  )

check <- q_clean %>% 
  distinct(on_date, on_date_raw)

# convert date clean date fields to date objects
q_clean <- q_clean %>%
  mutate(across(c(q_date, ia_date, on_date),
                ~as.POSIXct(., format = "%m/%d/%Y")))

# estimate duration variables
q_clean <- q_clean %>% 
  mutate(
    # Duration between q_date and ia_date in months
    ir_ia_dur_mon = as.numeric(difftime(ia_date, q_date, units = "days")) / 30.44,
    
    # Duration between ia_date and on_date in months
    ia_cod_dur_mon = as.numeric(difftime(on_date, ia_date, units = "days")) / 30.44,
    
    # duration between q_date and on_date
    ir_cod_dur_mon = as.numeric(difftime(on_date, q_date, units = "days")) / 30.44
  )

# create df for chart
ir_cod_all <- q_clean %>% 
  filter(!is.na(ir_cod_dur_mon)) %>% 
  mutate(on_year = year(on_date)) %>% 
  group_by(on_year) %>% 
  summarise(N = n(),
            p25 = quantile(ir_cod_dur_mon, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
            p50 = median(ir_cod_dur_mon, na.rm = TRUE),
            p75 = quantile(ir_cod_dur_mon, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  filter(on_year > 2004 & on_year <= 2023)


```

#### Create chart
```{r}
# plot: (c) Duration from IR to IA, 2014-2022
ir_cod_all_plot <- ggplot(data = ir_cod_all, aes(x = on_year, y = p50)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = p25, ymax = p75, fill = "25-75th percentile"), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(color = "Median"), size = 1.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = "darkolivegreen3") +
  scale_color_manual(values = "black") +
  theme_bw() +
  ylab("Duration IR to COD (Months)") +
  xlab("In-Service Year") +
  ggtitle("(c) Duration from IR to COD: 2005-2023") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(2005, 2023), breaks = c(2005:2023), expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0, 80), breaks = seq(0, 80, by = 10), expand = c(0.00, 0.00)) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.3),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, vjust = 0.1),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(r = 5)),
    legend.position = c(0.18,0.83),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(-0.2, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    #legend.box.background = element_rect(color = "black", size = 0.35),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12.5) 
  ) 


ir_cod_all_plot


```


### (d) Share of projects reaching COD for requests submitted from 2000-2018
#### Prep data
```{r}
# reshape to long
comp_rate_long <- pivot_longer(comp_rate , cols = c(count, gw), names_to = "type")

# Calculate percentages
comp_rate_long <- comp_rate_long %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  mutate(percent = value / sum(value) * 100)

# adjust values for type
comp_rate_long$type[comp_rate_long$type == "count"] <- "Number of Requests"
comp_rate_long$type[comp_rate_long$type == "gw"] <- "Capacity of Requests"

# reorder status as factor
comp_rate_long$status <- factor(comp_rate_long$status, 
                                levels = c("Withdrawn",
                                           "Active",
                                           "Operational"))

comp_rate_long$type <- factor(comp_rate_long$type, 
                                levels = c("Number of Requests",
                                           "Capacity of Requests"))


# define color palette
color_palette_d <- c(
  "gray75", #withdrawn
  "steelblue2", # active
  "#70AD47" # operational
)


```

#### Create chart
```{r}
# plot: (d) Share of projects reaching COD for requests submitted from 2000-2018
comp_rate_plot <- ggplot(comp_rate_long, aes(x = type, y = percent, fill = status)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette_d) +
  geom_text(aes(label = "18,132 Requests"), x = 1, y = 105, size = 4.5, color = "gray15") +
  geom_text(aes(label = "2,807 GW"), x = 2, y = 105, size = 4.5, color = "gray15") +
  geom_text(aes(label = "Withdrawn: 73%"), x = 1, y = 75, size = 4, color = "gray15") +
  geom_text(aes(label = "Active: 7%"), x = 1, y = 24, size = 4, color = "gray15") +
  geom_text(aes(label = "Operational: 20%"), x = 1, y = 10, size = 4, color = "gray15") +
  geom_text(aes(label = "Withdrawn: 78%"), x = 2, y = 75, size = 4, color = "gray15") +
  geom_text(aes(label = "Active: 8%"), x = 2, y = 18, size = 4, color = "gray15") +
  geom_text(aes(label = "Operational: 14%"), x = 2, y = 8, size = 4, color = "gray15") +
  theme_bw() +
  ylab("Share of Requests") +
  xlab("") +
  ggtitle("(d) Share of projects reaching COD: requests from 2000-2018") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0, 108), breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 25), expand = c(0.00, 0.00)) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_line(size = 0.25, linetype = "solid", colour = "gray10"),
    axis.line.y = element_line(size = 0.25, linetype = "solid", colour = "gray10"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12.5) 
    )

# remove tick, remove top and right borders
comp_rate_plot
```

## Figure 2: Projected capacity additions
### Prep data
#### Queued-Up projections
```{r}
# analysis assumptions
lag <- 5

## completion rate df (from slide 28 in queued up report)
### note: slides from Queued Up report available here: https://emp.lbl.gov/queues
rates_by_type <- data.frame(
  type = c("Battery", "Gas", "Solar", "Wind"),
  rate = c(0.05, 0.18, 0.10, 0.15)
)

## filter to year >= 2019 (we generate projections for 2024 through 2028)
queue_df <- queue_df %>% 
  rename(year = q_year) %>% 
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year),
         mw1 = as.numeric(mw1),
         mw2 = as.numeric(mw2),
         mw3 = as.numeric(mw3))

queue_df %>% count(year)

q_proj <- queue_df %>% 
  filter(!is.na(year),
         year >= 2019)

q_proj %>% count(year)

## isolate gas, wind, solar and battery capacity from queue data
q_proj %>% count(type_clean)

types <- q_proj %>% 
  distinct(type_clean, type1, type2, type3)

## adjust other+battery
q_proj <- q_proj %>% 
  mutate(type2 = if_else(type_clean == "Other+Battery", "Battery", type2))

## estimate capacity
q_proj <- q_proj %>% 
  mutate(standalone = if_else(type1 != "" & type2 == "" & type3 == "", 1, 0))

types <- q_proj %>% 
  distinct(type_clean, type1, type2, type3, standalone)

q_proj <- q_proj %>% 
  mutate(gas_mw = if_else(type1 == "Gas", mw1, 0),
         gas_mw = if_else(type2 == "Gas", mw2, gas_mw),
         wind_mw = if_else(type1 %in% c("Wind", "Offshore Wind"), mw1, 0),
         wind_mw = if_else(type2 %in% c("Wind", "Offshore Wind"), mw2, wind_mw),
         battery_mw = if_else(type1 == "Battery", mw1, 0),
         battery_mw = if_else(type2 == "Battery", mw2, battery_mw),
         battery_mw = if_else(type3 == "Battery", mw3, battery_mw),
         solar_mw = if_else(type1 == "Solar", mw1, 0),
         solar_mw = if_else(type2 == "Solar", mw2, solar_mw))

check <- q_proj %>% 
  select(type_clean, type1, type2, type3, mw1, mw2, mw3, gas_mw, wind_mw, battery_mw, solar_mw)

## pivot and collapse
q_proj_pivot <- q_proj %>% 
  select(year, gas_mw, wind_mw, battery_mw, solar_mw) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -year, names_to = "type", values_to = "mw") %>% 
  mutate(type = str_to_title(gsub("_mw", "", type)))

q_proj_pivot %>% count(type)

q_proj_collapse <- q_proj_pivot  %>% 
  group_by(year, type) %>% 
  summarise(mw = sum(mw, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(gw = mw/1000)

# add projected online year
q_proj <- q_proj_collapse %>% 
  mutate(online_year = year + lag) %>% 
  rename(gw_queue = gw)

# join comp rates by type
q_proj <- q_proj %>% 
  left_join(rates_by_type, by = "type")

# estimate projected gw
q_proj <- q_proj %>% 
  mutate(projected_capacity = gw_queue * rate)

# cumulative sum
q_proj <- q_proj %>% 
  arrange(type, online_year) %>% 
  group_by(type) %>% 
  mutate(cumul_projected_capacity = cumsum(projected_capacity)) %>% 
  ungroup()

# remove gas
q_proj <- q_proj %>% 
  filter(type != "Gas")

```

#### NZA (Princeton)
##### E+RE+ scenario
```{r}
# filter to projected installed capacity
nza_capacity <- nza_capacity %>% 
  filter(filter_level_3 == "Installed" & unit == "MW")

print(nza_capacity %>% distinct(variable_name))

# keep renewable resources
nza_capacity <- nza_capacity %>% 
  filter(variable_name %in% c(
    "Installed - Onshore wind",
    "Installed - Offshore wind",
    "Installed - Utility-scale PV",
    "Installed - Grid battery storage"
  ))

# capacity additions
nza_capacity <- nza_capacity %>% 
  mutate(mw = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", value))) %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarise(gw = sum(mw, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(cap_addition = gw - lag(gw),
         cap_addition = if_else(is.na(cap_addition), 0, cap_addition)) %>% 
  filter(year > 2020)

nza_capacity <- nza_capacity %>% 
  mutate(year_group = case_when(
    year >= 2021 & year <= 2025 ~ "2020 - 2025",
    year >= 2026 & year <= 2030 ~ "2026 - 2030",
    year >= 2031 & year <= 2035 ~ "2031 - 2035",
    year >= 2036 & year <= 2040 ~ "2036 - 2040",
    year >= 2041 & year <= 2045 ~ "2041 - 2045",
    year >= 2046 & year <= 2050 ~ "2046 - 2050",
    TRUE ~ ""
  ))

  
# interpolate values
years <- 2021:2050

year_group <- c(rep("2020 - 2025", 5),
                rep("2026 - 2030", 5),
                rep("2031 - 2035", 5),
                rep("2036 - 2040", 5),
                rep("2041 - 2045", 5),
                rep("2046 - 2050", 5))

nza_years <- data.frame(year = years, year_group = year_group)

nza_years <- nza_years %>%
  group_by(year_group) %>% 
  mutate(count = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(nza_capacity %>% select(year_group, cap_addition), by = "year_group") %>% 
  mutate(cap_add_interpolate = cap_addition / count) %>% 
  select(year, new_capacity_nza = cap_add_interpolate)

nza_capacity <- nza_years

# limit to 2024 - 2035
nza_capacity <- nza_capacity  %>% 
  filter(year >= 2024 & year <= 2035)


```

#### NREL
```{r}
# 95% CO2 reduction by 2050 case
nrel_2050_re <- nrel_df %>% 
  filter(scenario == "Mid_Case_95by2050") %>% 
  select(year = t, battery_4_MW, battery_8_MW, upv_MW, wind_offshore_MW, wind_onshore_MW, csp_MW) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(mw_total = sum(across(ends_with("_MW")), na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarise(gw = sum(mw_total, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(cap_addition_gw = gw - lag(gw)) %>% 
  rename(new_capacity_nrel_2050 = cap_addition_gw) %>% 
  select(year, new_capacity_nrel_2050)

## interpolate odd year capacity projections
nrel_years_2050_re <- data.frame(year = years, year_group = year_group) %>% 
  select(-c(year_group)) %>%
  filter(year >= 2025 & year <= 2050) %>% 
  left_join(nrel_2050_re, by = "year") %>% 
  mutate(gw_lead = lead(new_capacity_nrel_2050),
         gw_comb = if_else(is.na(gw_lead), new_capacity_nrel_2050, gw_lead),
         gw_interpolate = gw_comb / 2) %>% 
  select(year, new_capacity_nrel_2050 = gw_interpolate) %>% 
  filter(year >= 2025 & year <= 2035)

nrel_2050_re <- nrel_years_2050_re 

# 100% CO2 reduction by 2035
nrel_2035_re <- nrel_df %>% 
  filter(scenario == "Mid_Case_100by2035") %>% 
  select(year = t, battery_4_MW, battery_8_MW, upv_MW, wind_offshore_MW, wind_onshore_MW, csp_MW) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(mw_total = sum(across(ends_with("_MW")), na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarise(gw = sum(mw_total, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(cap_addition_gw = gw - lag(gw)) %>% 
  rename(new_capacity_nrel_2035 = cap_addition_gw) %>% 
  select(year, new_capacity_nrel_2035)

## interpolate odd year capacity projections

  select(-c(year_group)) %>%
  filter(year >= 2025 & year <= 2050) %>% 
  left_join(nrel_2035_re, by = "year") %>% 
  mutate(gw_lead = lead(new_capacity_nrel_2035),
         gw_comb = if_else(is.na(gw_lead), new_capacity_nrel_2035, gw_lead),
```

```{r}
propyr_plot <- ggplot(data = q_proj, aes(x = online_year, y = projected_capacity)) +
  # Bar plot
  geom_bar(data = q_proj[!is.na(q_proj$type), ], stat = "identity", position = "stack", 
           aes(fill = type, alpha = ifelse(online_year >= 2024, 0.5, 1)), width = 0.775) +
  scale_alpha_identity() +
  # Line plots
  geom_line(aes(y = new_capacity_2035, color = "2035 report (electric sector decarb by 2035)"), size = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_line(aes(y = new_capacity_nza, color = "Net Zero America (100% RE and electrification by 2050)"), size = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  #geom_line(aes(y = new_capacity_nza_e_minus, color = "Net Zero America (100% RE and less electrification by 2050)"), size = 1, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_line(aes(y = new_capacity_agu, color = "Williams et al (100% RE by 2050)"), size = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_line(aes(y = new_capacity_nrel_2035, color = "NREL Std Scenario (100% CO2 reduction by 2035)"), size = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_line(aes(y = new_capacity_nrel_2050, color = "NREL Std Scenario (95% CO2 reduction by 2050)"), size = 1, linetype = "dotted") +
  # Points
  geom_point(aes(y = new_capacity_2035), color = "gray35", size = 2, shape = 15) +
  geom_point(aes(y = new_capacity_nza), color = "#CC0000", size = 2, shape = 15) +
  #geom_point(aes(y = new_capacity_nza_e_minus), color = "#CC0000", size = 2, shape = 15) +
  geom_point(aes(y = new_capacity_agu), color = "#3366CC", size = 2, shape = 15) +
  geom_point(aes(y = new_capacity_nrel_2035), color = "darkorange", size = 2, shape = 15) +
  geom_point(aes(y = new_capacity_nrel_2050), color = "darkorange", size = 2, shape = 15) +
  # Legends
  scale_color_manual("Modeled Capacity:", 
                     values = c("2035 report (electric sector decarb by 2035)" = "gray35",
                                "Net Zero America (100% RE and electrification by 2050)" = "#CC0000",
                                "Williams et al (100% RE by 2050)" = "#3366CC",
                                "NREL Std Scenario (100% CO2 reduction by 2035)" = "darkorange",
                                "NREL Std Scenario (95% CO2 reduction by 2050)" = "darkorange")) +

  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 210), breaks = c(0, 50, 100, 150, 200)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2020, 2022, 2024, 2026, 2028, 2030, 2032, 2034)) +
  theme_bw() +
  ylab("Capacity (GW)") +
  xlab("Online Year") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = c(0.30, 0.85),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "italic"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8.5),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),

    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = "transparent",

      linetype = "solid"
    )
  ) +
  guides(
```
